crossRefs.note: Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever…
As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.
Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.
Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,
Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord…

I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God, the Almighty, and the Lamb, are its temple.
The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it, and its lamp is the Lamb.
As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.
My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?
Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.
I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land.
Yes, in the way of your judgments, Yahweh, we have waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.

yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t…
Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord…

translations.web: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.
translations.bsb: Whom have I in heaven but You? And on earth I desire no one besides You.
translations.kjv: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire
translations.asv: Whom have I in heaven but thee? And there is none upon earth that I desire besides thee.
